title: Birth of Moses
summary: Moses is born to Amram and Jochebed under Pharaoh's decree, hidden three months, and adopted by Pharaoh's daughter (Exod 2:1-10).
description: Moses was 80 when he spoke to Pharaoh (Exod 7:7), so he was born 80 years before the Exodus. CFAH-6 identifies the barren queen who adopted him with Sobekneferu (Argument 4 §12).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1571 BC (no higher-tier year available).
